If something goes wrong or changes, adapt and continue along the most cost-optimal path. </Expected workflow>

If there are two path with the same cost, you should pick the one with the least number of tool calls. - **One tool per step.** You may only call one tool at a time and SHOULD NOT call multiple tools in one request. If you output the format, your conversation would be terminated. - **Placeholders.** All the `{}` above are place-holders that you should fill in with the actual values. </Important rules>
